description:
A stylish and beautifully maintained one bedroom first floor apartment, complete with allocated parking and sold with no onward chain. An ideal first home, pied-à-terre or investment opportunity in one of Oxford’s most desirable central locations.

Set within a well kept residential block, the apartment offers light and welcoming accommodation throughout. The entrance hall leads to a spacious sitting/dining room flooded with natural light and benefitting from bespoke built-in storage, creating an elegant and practical living space. A well appointed kitchen and modern bathroom complement the layout, alongside a generously sized double bedroom.

To the rear of the building, residents benefit from a designated private parking space and a secondary entrance directly from the parking area, adding security and day to day convenience.

Occupying a prime position in Grandpont, the property enjoys a wonderful neighbourhood feel with a strong sense of community. Local highlights include a highly regarded primary school and Hinksey Park with its outdoor heated swimming pool and beautiful green spaces. Oxford city centre is an effortless half-mile stroll, placing the Westgate shopping centre, theatres, museums, restaurants and riverside walks all within minutes of the front door.

A rare opportunity to acquire a low-maintenance, centrally located property with superb lifestyle benefits and immediate availability. Early viewing highly recommended.
